properties.name: krandom.seed
properties.description: Optional numeric PRNG seed for reproducible generated data.

properties.name: krandom.locale
properties.description: Locale tag used by locale-aware generators. Accepts BCP 47 tags such as en-US and underscore tags such as en_US.

properties.name: krandom.object-max-depth
properties.description: Maximum nesting depth for reflection-based object generation.

properties.name: krandom.object-null-probability
properties.description: Probability from 0.0 to 1.0 that a nullable reference field is generated as null during object generation.

properties.name: krandom.min-string-length
properties.description: Minimum length for generated strings.

properties.name: krandom.max-string-length
properties.description: Maximum length for generated strings.

properties.name: krandom.min-collection-size
properties.description: Minimum size for generated collections and arrays.

properties.name: krandom.max-collection-size
properties.description: Maximum size for generated collections and arrays.

properties.name: krandom.recipe
properties.description: Portable serialized generation recipe. It cannot be combined with krandom.seed or krandom.locale.

properties.name: krandom.clock
properties.description: ISO-8601 instant used as a fixed clock for deterministic temporal generation.

properties.name: krandom.clock-zone
properties.description: IANA zone ID for krandom.clock. It requires krandom.clock and otherwise defaults to UTC.

properties.name: krandom.payment-card-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for payment-card fixtures. The default deliberately produces non-Luhn values.

properties.name: krandom.phone-number-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for telephone-number fixtures.

properties.name: krandom.national-id-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for national-identifier fixtures. The default disables generation.

properties.name: krandom.banking-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for banking-identifier fixtures. The default disables generation.

properties.name: krandom.securities-identifier-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for securities-identifier fixtures. The default disables generation.

properties.name: krandom.crypto-address-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for crypto-address fixtures. The default disables generation.

properties.name: krandom.business-tax-identifier-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for business tax-identifier fixtures. The default disables generation.

properties.name: krandom.identity-document-safety-policy
properties.description: Safety policy for identity-document fixtures. The default disables generation.

properties.name: krandom.object-construction-policy
properties.description: Construction policy for generated objects. The default calls safe constructors.
